data.narrative:
Auterion, a Series B-stage defense and security company founded by Lorenz Meier and Kevin Sartori, has raised $130M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms in the same sector and stage, including Dream Security, Allen Control Systems, Harmattan AI, Code Metal, and Twenty.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $130M total raised as a proxy base valuation and applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B-to-later-stage progression, yielding $247M. Peer-median analysis across the 8 private comparables in Defense & Security at Series B stage produces a median valuation of $1.1B, with a range spanning $300M to $3.0B. The dispersion reflects material differences in market positioning and capital efficiency within the peer cohort.

The two methods produce a triangulated range of $210M (low) to $1.3B (high), with a median of $686M. The significant gap between methods reflects tension between Auterion's capital-raise trajectory and peer valuations. Key uncertainties include revenue traction relative to peers, customer concentration, and whether the peer set adequately reflects Auterion's specific market position within defense and security infrastructure. Further diligence on revenue multiples and growth rates would sharpen this range.
